faq.title: FAQ
faq.desc: Answers to common questions about registration and applications.
faq.q1: How do I create an account and start applying?
faq.a1: Click “Login”, complete your basic details, then open Jobs, pick a role, and submit your application.
faq.q2: Can I edit my application after submitting?
faq.a2: You can update your profile anytime. Submitted applications can’t be edited, but you may withdraw and reapply.
faq.a3: We target an initial review within 48 hours. You’ll receive updates via email and your dashboard.
faq.a4: Selection follows MOEHE criteria with workforce localization considered whenever the required skills are available.
